name: work-pack
title: Draft maintenance work pack
for_each: select id,code from work_orders where status<>'completed'

sections.title: Job and isolation reference
sections.sql: select w.code,a.name,a.site,w.title,w.due_date,w.assigned_to,w.isolation_ref from work_orders w join assets a on a.id=w.asset_id where w.id=$1
sections.note: Planning record only. Site isolation, competency and permits must be checked by the responsible person before work.

sections.title: Parts issued
sections.sql: select s.code,s.name,-m.quantity as issued from stock_moves m join spares s on s.id=m.spare_id where m.work_order_id=$1

sections.title: Maintenance history
sections.sql: select code,title,status,completed_by,completion_note,completed_at,isolation_ref from work_orders where asset_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Inspection evidence
sections.sql: select inspected_on,next_due,inspector,competency_ref,evidence_ref,result,finding from inspections where asset_id=$1 order by inspected_on

name: parts-request
title: Draft parts purchase request
for_each: select id,id::text as name from purchase_requests

sections.title: Requested parts
sections.sql: select s.code,s.name,p.quantity,p.reason,p.requested_by,p.status from purchase_requests p join spares s on s.id=p.spare_id where p.id=$1
sections.note: Internal draft. No supplier order has been placed.
